name: Band-e Amir National Park
story: Band-e Amir National Park is located in the central Bamyan Province of Afghanistan. Established on 22 May 2009, it protects a chain of six intensely blue lakes created by natural travertine dams high in the Hindu Kush.
matters: The park provides a pristine landscape and habitat for over 170 bird species, including populations of Himalayan snowcocks within its designated Important Bird Area.
